mapper.select: select a.name_ ,a.shareholders_code ,a.identify_type ,a.identify_number as unisc_code ,b.rel_type ,b.relation ,b.shareholding_ratio ,b.pid ,b.from_pid ,b.to_pid ,a.hole_share_amount from bus_rel_psn a left join bus_rel b on a.pid=b.from_pid where b.to_pid=#{pid} and b.to_type in ('SUSPSN','SUSORG') and b.from_type = 'PSN'

select a.org_name as name ,a.shareholders_code ,a.identify_type ,a.unisc_code ,b.rel_type ,b.relation ,b.shareholding_ratio ,a.hole_share_amount from bus_rel_org a left join bus_rel b on a.pid=b.from_pid where b.to_pid=#{pid} and b.to_type in('SUSPSN','SUSORG') and b.from_type = 'ORG'

select a.org_name as name ,a.shareholders_code ,a.identify_type ,a.unisc_code ,b.rel_type ,b.relation ,b.shareholding_ratio ,a.hole_share_amount from bus_rel_org a left join bus_rel b on a.pid=b.from_pid and b.to_type='ORG' and b.is_show!=0 where b.to_pid=#{pid}

select a.name_ ,a.shareholders_code ,a.identify_type ,a.identify_number as unisc_code ,b.rel_type ,b.relation ,b.shareholding_ratio ,b.pid ,b.from_pid ,b.to_pid ,a.hole_share_amount from bus_rel_psn a left join bus_rel b on a.pid=b.from_pid and b.to_type='PSN' and b.is_show!=0 where b.to_pid=#{pid}
